axes.model_access: Multi-model aggregation is its native form: the official page on the day shows "Chat with the best AI… Explore GPT-5, Claude-Sonnet-5, DeepSeek-R1, Veo-3.1, and thousands of others" — users pick models and chat directly, models connect via Poe's side to each vendor's API (point costs differ per model).
axes.runtime: Web (poe.com) + iOS/Android apps; chats are relayed through Poe's servers to each model API, nothing runs locally. poe.com returned 307→login 403 to headless fetching on the day (login wall + CF, not a dead link).
axes.local_files: Chat history stored on the account side, synced after login; no locally-held data surface declared by the vendor — every model call is relayed through Poe's servers, so conversation content necessarily passes the Poe side (a structural premise of an aggregation-relay product, not an optional toggle).
axes.background: Chat returns instantly; no official statement verified for an async-task form. The points system limits usage on high-frequency/long-context models.
axes.tools: The official page on the day shows group chat, Leaderboard, and a bot-creation surface (build your own bot on a model + persona); image/video models (Veo-3.1 on record) are also in the aggregation list. No MCP support verified in official statements.
axes.context: Chats organized per conversation, synced after login; bot personas (self-built bots binding a model + persona) are a persistent configuration surface reused across sessions. Context-window length varies per underlying model; Poe's product-level cross-session memory mechanism has no verified official statement.
axes.permissions: Account system (register + login); the points system is the usage-permission surface; training-usage toggle path not verified item by item — Poe previously drew controversy over "user chats used for training" terms; read the current official Terms/Privacy item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: using many vendors' models under one account (domestic DeepSeek models included), building your own bot personas. Not a fit: unlimited free flagship models (points system), direct mainland access (not filed), data not relayed through Poe.
